claim: For the real Banaś–Frączek plane \(R_\lambda^2=(\mathbb R^2,N_\lambda)\), \(N_\lambda(x_1,x_2)=\max\{\lambda|x_1|,\sqrt{x_1^2+x_2^2}\}\), the Ptolemy constant satisfies \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}(R_\lambda^2)=\lambda\) for every \(1<\lambda\le\sqrt2\).
integrity: The mathematical proof is self-contained and does not depend on computation or on the access-limited source. Literature comparisons distinguish directly inspected implications from the explicitly retained access residual.
scientific_limitations: The equality is proved only for 1<lambda<=sqrt(2); no exact claim is made for the remaining parameters. The 2015 Acta Mathematica Sinica comparison source was available only through metadata and abstract in bounded lawful access attempts. The 1993 print source predates the exact day-level DML-CZ availability timestamp, so 2009-01-08 is used as the earliest exact public-source date verified at day resolution.
title: Exact Ptolemy constant \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}=\lambda\) on the first Banaś–Frączek regime
